**Answer.** To fix the pitch stability of the 3 mm glider while minimizing the sink rate penalty, we should increase the horizontal tail area. Enforcing the 10% minimum static margin raises the sink rate to `{python} f"{sr_tail:.3f}"` m/s when freeing the tail area, compared to `{python} f"{sr_boom:.3f}"` m/s when lengthening the tail boom and `{python} f"{sr_sweep:.3f}"` m/s when adding wing sweep.
